review.alternative: A cached mutable state could theoretically perform faster if eventual consistency were acceptable.
review.would_change_mind: Evidence of a mutable, non-replayed state cache actively modifying system behavior.

claims.statement: State reconstruction in WAKE is strictly deterministic, relying on replay of accepted operations rather than a mutable state cache.

support.explanation: This confirms the rejection of mutable state caches in favor of event-based reconstruction.
support.passage: Current state is never trusted as a separate cache. ``replay`` starts from an empty mapping, verifies every event in sequence, and applies only accepted operations.

review.alternative: The system could permit optimistic execution followed by rollback.

claims.statement: The governance module enforces state validity by rejecting invalid proposals before they are appended to the durable record.

support.explanation: This establishes the separation of concerns: proposals are model-generated, validation is governance-enforced.
support.passage: The model is allowed to PROPOSE changes to durable state. It is never allowed to decide whether those changes are valid.

actions.findings:
State reconstruction in WAKE is strictly deterministic, relying on replay of accepted operations rather than a mutable state cache. [source-c07acfeebe1548f6]

The governance module enforces state validity by rejecting invalid proposals before they are appended to the durable record. [source-be48d836aaf44716]
actions.limitations: Current model scope restricted to structural record analysis; lacks runtime verification of concurrent event ingestion.
actions.next_questions: Does the atomicity of the SQLite transaction prevent partial writes when a proposal is rejected during the governance check?
actions.reason: Revising to integrate governance and record store roles in operational state modeling.
actions.summary: WAKE models operational state through a deterministic replay of accepted events, ensuring that current state is never cached but derived from an authoritative, append-only SQLite log. Governance acts as the sole validator for proposals, preventing invalid states from entering the durable chain.
actions.title: Provisional Foundations of WAKE Durable Record

proposal.summary: WAKE achieves state integrity by strictly separating model proposals from governance-validated state transitions within an append-only event record. The operational state is not cached but reconstructed via replay, ensuring that invalid proposals remain outside the durable history.
proposal.title: WAKE Architectural Synthesis: Proposal vs. Governance
